# Daniel Moretti

> Official website of Daniel Moretti, a Chile-based senior product engineer and former co-founder/CTO with 10+ years of production software experience.

Daniel works across product engineering, backend systems, infrastructure, and security. His current technical focus includes Rust, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Temporal, production AI-agent workflows, voice AI, and Linux. He co-founded Mappa and built its product from the first commit to more than 100 B2B customers across the Americas.

This website is the canonical source for Daniel Moretti's biography, work, open-source projects, resume, and software-engineering articles.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio and biography](https://danielmoretti.com/): Career summary, technical focus, selected work, and experience.
- [Resume](https://danielmoretti.com/resume.pdf): One-page professional resume.
- [Mappa case study](https://danielmoretti.com/showcase/mappa): Voice behavior-decoding platform Daniel built as co-founder and CTO.
- [Open-source work](https://danielmoretti.com/showcase/open-source): Rust, TypeScript, AI-agent, Wayland, and Linux projects.
- [E-Ficha case study](https://danielmoretti.com/showcase/e-ficha): Medical administration software.
- [DarSpa case study](https://danielmoretti.com/showcase/darspa): Healthcare-center website and integrations.
- [Software engineering blog](https://danielmoretti.com/blog): Articles written by Daniel.
- [Blog RSS feed](https://danielmoretti.com/blog/rss.xml): Machine-readable publication feed.
